lines.say: A pope dug up a corpse and put it on trial.
caps: A pope dug up a corpse

lines.say: The guy had been dead nine months. They sat him on a throne and gave him a lawyer.
Guilty. They cut off three fucking fingers and threw him in the river.
Not one word in his own defense. Dead guys don't text back.
Within months, the pope who ran it got thrown in prison and strangled. Karma, bitch.
You do the same thing. A client goes quiet, and you've already decided he's gone.
